title: Hot-spring steam & geysir bursts
summary: Strokkur erupts every 6–10 minutes with almost no warning — be set before it goes.
why: The burst lasts two seconds. There's no time to meter, focus, or think — everything is pre-set and the finger is on the shutter when the water dome swells. Steam itself is a bright diffuse subject that meters like fog: a touch of +comp keeps it white, not grey.

steps.text: Mode dial to S, rear dial to 1/1000
Pre-focus on the pool edge, then wait — don't re-focus during the burst
Watch the dome: it swells blue-green a half-second before it goes
Hold the burst through the whole eruption

pitfalls: Stand upwind — steam on the front element fogs every following frame, and the sulfur mist is corrosive on contacts.
levelUp: Backlit steam at low sun is the shot: position the plume between you and the sun, −0.7 EV, and it glows like slow fire.
